description: Create a new personal AI voice from a natural-language description (Gemini Voice Design). Uses one slot of the user's custom-voice quota - confirm with the user first. Good for a unique narrator or a character voice in a video/podcast. Returns the new `voice` token.

prompt.description: Describe age, accent, timbre, personality, energy and pace. Example: 'Calm male documentary narrator in his 40s, deep warm timbre, slow confident pace, neutral American accent.'

name: design_custom_voice
title: Design a custom voice
